footer.tagline: Sniser provides an innovative solution to protect artists' creativity using blockchain technology.

meta.title: About Sniser — Money for music, ownership for fans
meta.description: Sniser is a music platform where artists keep ownership, fans own transferable access passes, and royalties pay forever.

hero.heading: We build the platform we wished existed for music.
hero.body: Sniser started in 2024 between Casablanca and London with a simple question: what if fans actually owned what they paid for, and artists earned from every resale forever? Two years later we run exclusive drops with 120+ artists across hip-hop, electronic, and afrobeats.

ownership.title: Artists keep ownership
ownership.body: Every release is structured so the artist holds rights, royalties, and direction. We don't take masters, ever.

access.title: Fans actually own access
access.body: Access is a transferable asset on-chain. If a fan walks away, they can sell it — and the artist still earns from that resale.

web3.title: Web3 should feel invisible
web3.body: Crossmint handles wallets in the background. Email login, card checkout, no seed phrases. Crypto only when it makes things better.

meta.title: FAQ — Sniser
meta.description: Answers about how Sniser works — access passes, royalties, payments, and what fans actually own.

hero.heading: Frequently asked questions
hero.body: Everything about how Sniser works — ownership, payments, resale royalties, and getting started.

own.q: What exactly do I own when I buy access?
own.a: You own a non-fungible access pass that lives in your wallet. As long as you hold it, you can stream the content. If you sell the pass, access transfers cleanly to the new buyer — no manual de-licensing required.

crypto.q: Do I need to know anything about crypto?
crypto.a: No. Sign in with Google or email via Crossmint, and a wallet is created for you in the background. You can move to a self-custody wallet later if you want.

royalty.q: How does artist royalty on resale work?
royalty.a: Every access pass has a built-in royalty (usually 5–10%) encoded in its smart contract. When a fan resells on the Sniser Marketplace, that royalty is paid automatically to the artist on every transaction — forever.

payments.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
payments.a: Card (Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay, Google Pay) is processed via Crossmint. If you'd rather pay in stablecoins (USDC) we support that natively at checkout.

fee.a: 10% on the primary drop and 2.5% on each resale. Artists set the price and the royalty split themselves; we never touch the rest.

mobile.q: Can I watch on my phone?
mobile.a: Yes. Your access is wallet-bound, not device-bound — sign into Sniser on any browser and your library is there. We're shipping iOS and Android apps next.

artist.q: I'm an artist. How do I join?
artist.a: Use the 'Message us on WhatsApp' button on the artist page. Send a short pitch and 1–2 unreleased tracks. Our A&R team reviews everything within five business days.

exclusive.q: Is my content actually exclusive after release?
exclusive.a: Yes — all Sniser drops are platform-exclusive by contract. The content isn't published to streaming services, social feeds, or third-party stores during the exclusivity window.

cta.heading: Still have questions?
cta.body: Our team replies within one business day.

meta.title: Terms of Service — Sniser
meta.description: Read the terms that govern your use of Sniser — accounts, access passes, payments, royalties, and dispute resolution.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.summary: These are placeholder Terms. Before public launch, {{company}} should replace them with the version reviewed by qualified counsel in every jurisdiction where Sniser operates.

agreement.title: 1. Agreement
agreement.body: By creating an account, connecting a wallet, or purchasing an access pass on Sniser, you agree to these Terms. If you don't agree, you must not use the service.

accounts.title: 2. Accounts
accounts.body: You can sign in with an email address (via Crossmint) or a self-custody wallet. You are responsible for safeguarding your credentials. Sniser never stores seed phrases and cannot recover a wallet for you.

passes.title: 3. Access passes
passes.body: An access pass is a transferable digital asset that grants the holder the right to stream the associated content for as long as they hold the pass. Selling or transferring the pass transfers access; Sniser revokes the previous holder's playback automatically.

items.notInvestments: Access passes are not investments. Their value depends on demand and is not guaranteed.
items.royalties: Resale royalties are encoded in each pass and paid to the artist on every transfer.
items.noCustody: Sniser does not custody assets — passes live in your connected wallet.

payments.title: 4. Payments and fees
payments.body: Card payments are processed by Crossmint; on-chain payments settle in USDC. Sniser charges a 10% platform fee on primary drops and a 2.5% fee on resale. Artists set their own prices and royalty splits.

artistAgreements.title: 5. Artist agreements
artistAgreements.body: Releases on Sniser are platform-exclusive for the period defined in each artist agreement. Artists retain ownership of their masters. The full artist agreement is provided before signing.

items.circumvent: Circumventing the access-pass mechanism (recording, scraping, or sharing decoded streams).
items.reselling: Reselling content you do not hold a valid pass for.
items.scraping: Automated scraping of catalog metadata at a rate that affects service quality.

disclaimer.title: 7. Disclaimer and liability
disclaimer.body: The service is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. To the maximum extent permitted by law, Sniser is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the service.

changes.title: 8. Changes
changes.body: We may update these Terms. Material changes will be announced via email or in-app notification at least 14 days before they take effect.

meta.title: Privacy Policy — Sniser
meta.description: What Sniser collects, why, who we share it with, and how to exercise your data rights.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.summary: This is a placeholder Privacy Policy intended to be replaced by {{company}}'s qualified counsel ahead of launch. It is not legal advice.

items.account: Account data: email, display name, and authentication tokens.
items.wallet: Wallet data: public wallet address(es) you connect. We never store private keys.
items.payment: Payment data: handled by Crossmint; we receive a transaction reference, not card numbers.
items.usage: Usage data: pages visited, drops viewed, basic device info, IP — used to operate and improve the service.

use.title: 2. How we use it
use.body: To deliver and secure the service, fulfill purchases, pay artist royalties, comply with legal obligations, and improve product quality. We do not sell personal data.

cookies.title: 3. Cookies and analytics
cookies.body: Essential cookies keep you signed in and your cart consistent. Analytics cookies are optional and only set after you accept them via the cookie banner. You can change consent at any time.

items.cloud: Cloud infrastructure providers — to host the service.
items.law: Law enforcement — only when legally required and after due review.

rights.title: 5. Your rights
rights.body: Subject to local law, you can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data. To exercise these rights, email <mail>{{email}}</mail> from the address on the account.

retention.title: 6. Data retention
retention.body: Account data is retained for as long as the account is active, plus the period required to meet tax and audit obligations. On-chain transactions are public by nature and cannot be deleted.

security.title: 7. Security
security.body: We use encryption in transit (TLS) and at rest, scoped access controls, and routine reviews. No system is fully secure — please use a strong password and a separate, hardware-backed wallet for high-value holdings.

changes.title: 8. Changes
changes.body: We will announce material changes to this Policy via email or in-app notification at least 14 days before they take effect.

meta.title: How to View Content on Sniser
meta.description: Sign in with Crossmint, verify your access on-chain, and watch exclusive content anywhere. Resell your access anytime on the Sniser Marketplace.

hero.body: Buy access to unlock exclusive Sniser content and own the rights permanently in your digital wallet. Trade on the marketplace whenever you're ready to flip your seat — secure, transparent, and built for fans for the long haul.

step1.title: YOUR ACCOUNT
step1.description: Hit "Start Session" on the Sniser platform. You don't need to worry about seed phrases or complicated crypto setups. Just sign in to your Crossmint account using Google or Microsoft for a fast, secure login.
step1.callout: Crossmint instantly connects your wallet behind the scenes — zero crypto knowledge needed.

step2.title: VERIFY YOUR ACCESS
step2.description: We handle the technical side. Sniser automatically checks that your connected Crossmint wallet holds the ownership rights to the content you're trying to view. It's a secure, transparent connection built entirely on the blockchain. Once ownership is verified, you're good to go.

step3.title: UNLOCKS AUTOMATICALLY
step3.description: No waiting rooms or download links. Once your access is confirmed by the network, the exclusive content unlocks instantly right on your screen. Just hit "Play" and enjoy the front-row view.

step4.title: ANYTIME, ANYWHERE
step4.description: Your access isn't locked to a specific app or device — it stays attached to your wallet. Whether you're signed in on your phone or desktop, your content is always available wherever you sign in.

step5.title: YOUR ACCESS ANYTIME
step5.description: Done watching? List your access rights on the Sniser Marketplace and sell them to another fan. The moment it sells, ownership and access seamlessly transfer to the new buyer. You get paid, the artist's smart contract automatically earns a royalty cut, and Sniser takes a standard commission.

meta.title: Sniser — Money For Your Music
meta.description: Bring the talent, we bring the booking. Sniser handles releases, production, and fan-owned content on the blockchain so artists get paid fairly.

hero.title:
Money For
Your Music
hero.body: You bring the talent — we bring the booking. Sniser invests real capital into your sound so you can stay in the booth and out of the red. You keep creating. We handle the business. We grow together.
hero.imageAlt: Recording artist performing on stage under studio lights

noUpfront.title: No Upfront Costs
noUpfront.description: We invest in you. We cover the financial side so you don't have to stress about the budget.

opportunities.title: Exclusive Opportunities
opportunities.description: Connect with your peers. We provide a platform built specifically to elevate your career.

support.title: Full-Service Support
support.description: From studio to sale. We are with you at every stage of the creative and release process.

process.heading: How It Works
process.intro: From first pitch to profit share — five deliberate steps, each one fully handled by the Sniser team so you can stay focused on the music.

contact.title: SNISER
contact.description: It starts with a pitch. Send us your details, your unreleased cuts, a breakdown of your style, and your aspirations. We don't sign everyone — our team reviews your catalog to gauge your raw potential and figure out exactly how your sound fits the Sniser audience.
contact.imageAlt: Sniser A&R team celebrating a new artist signing

agreement.title: CONTENT AGREEMENT
agreement.description: If we love the music, we lock in the deal. Hop on Zoom and draft a straightforward agreement: we work together to build, record, and drop exclusive music meant strictly for release on the Sniser platform.
agreement.imageAlt: Two people shaking hands to close an exclusive deal

studio.title: PRODUCTION & MIXING
studio.description: Time to hit the lab. We plug you into our network of partner recording studios. You get a professional tracking environment and work with top-tier engineers to make sure the record hits as hard as it should. The best part? Sniser covers the production costs.
studio.imageAlt: Studio microphone glowing under warm session lights

release.title: PLATFORM RELEASE
release.description: The drop. Your album goes live exclusively on the Sniser platform. While the music lives securely on our site, our marketing team goes to work — blasting promotional teasers across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube to drive every bit of mainstream traffic directly to your release.
release.videoLabel: Crowd with hands raised at a live show under stage lasers

revenue.title: GENERATION & PROFIT SHARE
revenue.description: Attention turns into capital. Fans purchase direct access to your exclusive content right on Sniser. The revenue is split between you and the platform based on the exact percentages laid out in your deal. You get paid for your art.
revenue.imageAlt: Analytics dashboard showing audience and revenue growth

network.heading: Tap Into The Network
network.body: We don't broadcast every move publicly. Open submission windows, platform updates, and new investment calls go straight to our trusted list. Get inside the room and stay locked in.
network.imageAlt: Neon sign reading No Music No Life
